end.summary:
Practised estimating a large collection using groups of 10 as a guide.
Ananya attempted two estimates without an unaided correct response.
They counted the number of groups as the total number of objects once.
They identified four groups of 10 as 40, but the group-counting mix-up was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised using a known group of 10 to estimate a larger collection. Ananya worked with the spoken group counts and correctly connected four groups of 10 with 40, but needed the collection and groups to be shown clearly; the mix-up between counting groups and counting objects remained at the end. At home, show a small pile arranged in groups of 10 and ask, “How many groups? How many objects altogether?”
